sec.t: ff.135.1 The costs of Artificial Intelligence
sec.p: According to some, ChatGPT is pushing up electricity bills: Federal Reserve data show an increase from 0.17 to 0.19 $/kWh (in Europe, eclipsed by the far more tangible effects of the war in Ukraine).
All this is nothing compared with the plans for the future:

sec.t: ff.135.3 Are we in the singularity?
sec.p: All this energy, though, is for (and has already been used for) something.

AGI and the singularity are a bonus: Dave Blundin, in the same podcast, points out that even if AI development stopped today, it would take years to digest, explore and implement its potential applications.

rel: ff.82 A war fought with chips
